findings.what: Every existing caller that already wrote its continuation lines with a two-space indent (as the old test message did) now renders with four spaces, and the commit updates none of them, so all current multi-line table messages silently change layout.
A continuation line that is whitespace-only rather than empty is still prefixed with two spaces, emitting the trailing-whitespace line the empty-line check was meant to prevent.
